sloka: विनियुक्तास्ततो राज्ञा शिल्पिनो विश्वकर्मवत् ।विस्तीर्णं योजनं शुभ्रं ततो द्विगुणमायतम् ।। ७.१३.३ ॥
transliteration: viniyuktāstato rājñā śilpino viśvakarmavat ।vistīrṇaṁ yojanaṁ śubhraṁ tato dviguṇamāyatam ।। 7.13.3 ॥

translations.english: Then, artisans like Vishvakarma were appointed by the king to construct a splendid dwelling, one yojana wide and twice that in length.
